register.labelZh: POP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: pop in 可以描述短暫探訪;pop something in 或 round 則可以表示順道把某物送到另一地方。；pop off 可以表示某人迅速或提早離開;pop something on 則可以表示迅速穿上衣物。；pop out 表示某物從藏身處突然走出或冒出;pop up 則表示人物、物件、訊息或問題意外出現。；這些 POP 表達常用於談論探訪、送遞物品、衣服、工作、行程、螢幕訊息和意外事件。
register.summaryEn: Pop in describes a brief visit. Pop something in or round describes taking something somewhere without making a long visit. Pop off can show that someone leaves quickly or early. Pop something on describes putting on clothes without taking much time. Pop out shows something coming from a hidden place. Pop up shows a person, object, message or problem appearing unexpectedly. These POP expressions are useful when talking about visits, deliveries, clothes, work, journeys, screens and unexpected events.
